name: Halict API
description:
Halict is a form tool. It asks one question at a time, and turns every response
into a case you can stage, assign, tag and follow up by email.

This API lets you read and write those forms and responses from your own systems,
and subscribe to events so you hear about a new response the moment it arrives.

## Authentication

Every endpoint takes an API key in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer qk_live_xxxxxxxx
```

Issue a key in Halict under **Settings → API Keys**. A key belongs to one workspace,
and every call is scoped to that workspace. Keys are shown once, so store yours safely.

## Events (webhooks)

Instead of polling, register a URL with `POST /webhooks/subscribe` and Halict will
post to it the moment a response arrives or its stage changes. Delete the subscription
with `DELETE /webhooks/subscribe/{id}` when you no longer need it.
